g_interplay.quote: FAST ORDER: "Collect your actions of type reply, decision and hold on in-scope rows ... plus the reply actions STEP 1 finds ... within a type, the oldest raised first." ACTIONS: "messages from us in your Sent to that recipient on the action's thread ... since the action was raised". Check 1: "any page short or unread: no send that uses wording or rules". UN#: "Links on un#: unhashed.co/sponsored and unhashed.co/precall only." SHOW CHECK: "every fact about a show (... links) comes word for word from that show's pitch sheet".
g_interplay.trace: FAST ORDER: STEP 0r's actions are neither Next action segments nor STEP 1 replies, so it's unclear whether they're collected or capped, and in what order. If they are, raised = event start (the future) sorts them last (D6). PRE-SEND check 5 (ACTIONS 'since raised'): raised is in the future, so the generic Sent check never finds a candidate and only STEP 0r's own link check guards (D6). Check 1 tests only whether the page loaded, not whether the toggle exists. A missing toggle passes check 1, and STEP 0r has no fallback (D3). LEAK CHECK: the toggle text is clean. SHOW CHECK and SCOPE: on un#, Built to Share and Human by Design the link lists are exclusive ('only'), and the zencastr link is on no pitch sheet. So a client-show send either fails SHOW CHECK (Akshay ask) or breaks SCOPE (D7). 'At most one link': the toggle has one {link}, PASS. Per-run and daily cap: sends count, and logged hand sends count too (D12). Quiet hours: honoured. Page-wins: 'Where a page and this prompt differ, the page wins, except for the HARD RULES'. If Rules for Zoya keeps its own approved-links list without zencastr.app.link, the page's narrower list governs. That list is what blocked the link on 2 Nov (D10).

verdict.suggested_step_0r: STEP 0r. RECORDING LINKS (decision 445; Akshay, 3 Nov: "have Zoya send - I don't want to send manually"). Founder Thesis only (client shows use their own rooms; a link for a client-show row: report it). Every run, read the mails in your inbox from Mamatha (tagged Team) in the last 14 days that carry zencastr.app.link guest links (a line with two links or one marked host: send nothing, report it). Each link line names a guest and company: match it to one Founder Thesis Engagement at Status Booked whose recording is on Akshay's calendar, in the future (a recording already past: skip it; no match, or two the line's date can't separate: send nothing, report it once). Its action key: "<row id>:reply:call-recording-link-<event id>:<event start ISO>" (ACTIONS; a reply action that goes first among replies, soonest recording first; its Sent check runs from the arrival of Mamatha's mail). Already done when a "Zoya sent: recording link to <guest>" Activity exists for it, or a mail from us (your Sent or ad@'s Sent) carries that link in its own text, not a quote, to the guest or anyone on their side: send nothing, log the Activity if missing. Else send it in the first run after the link arrives (quiet hours aside), never later than the day before the recording: the "Recording link" toggle from the wording page (no such toggle: send nothing, report "wording missing: Recording link"; a recording within 48 hours goes on Akshay's list), on the guest's own thread (THREADING), To the guest (else their company-side contact, as SENDING's guest-facing rule says), Cc their side from the thread and Akshay, the time in the guest's zone (the thread or row; unknown: IST). A row waiting on Akshay for another ask still gets it; an Akshay hold on this recording (no-show, cancellation, reschedule) holds it. Then the link add on that recording event: its location the link if empty, and a first description line "Recording link (Zencastr): <link>"; notificationLevel ALL; never move, remove or change anything else (an event you can't edit: report it). Set the row's Call link to the link if empty. Log "Zoya sent: recording link to <guest>" (Kind Email out, Source ID per MESSAGE IDENTITY, Action key) and a Claude note line; remove any "Akshay: no recording room" segment for it and his Waiting on entry (OWNERS). A Founder Thesis Booked recording within 24 hours with no room link anywhere (Mamatha's mails, the invite's location or description, the row's Call link): once (Claude note "recording room asked <event id>"), Akshay in Waiting on and the segment "Akshay: no recording room for <guest> (<D Mon HH:MM JST>)".
verdict.suggested_hard_rule: - Never move, cancel or edit a calendar event with guests on it beyond INVITES' adds and STEP 0r's link add (a call their side cancelled in writing is the calendar run's, decision 398).
